sections.name: Verse 1
lines: And still in loneliness she waits,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: How long, O Lord our God,
Wilt Thou not judge Thy suffering church,
Her sighs and tears and blood?

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: We long to hear Thy voice,
To see Thee face to face,
To share Thy crown and glory then,
As now we share Thy grace.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: The curse, the sin, the stain,
And make this blighted world of ours
